title: Inter's papers went 4 for 14 this week — here's the scorecard
caption:
Inter's press made 14 reported claims this week. Four came true, none were denied, ten are still hanging. Quotidiano Sportivo called Calhanoglu's return and the club confirmed it; Gazzetta dello Sport's 100 million valuation for Pio Esposito and Corriere dello Sport's English interest in Petar Sucic are both still open. Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
